description:
Price the same project at economy, mid-range and premium quality side by side.

    Use it when a homeowner asks "what's the difference between a basic and a
    high-end job?" or wants to choose a budget level.

    Args:
        home_sqft: Finished square footage of the home (200-20000).
        num_rooms: Number of rooms (1-50).
        services: Services to price, e.g. ["flooring", "painting"].
        zip_code: 5-digit US ZIP code of the property, for regional labor pricing.
        state: Two-letter state code, used when the ZIP is unknown.
        stories: Above-grade stories (1, 1.5, 2 or 3; default 1).
        flooring_type: For flooring only: carpet, tile, vinyl, hardwood or mix.
        num_windows: For windows only: actual window count, if known.
        include_permits: Add estimated permit fees.
        include_contingency: Add a 10% contingency allowance.

    Returns the total for each tier, a per-service breakdown for each tier, and
    each service's totals across the three tiers.
name: compare_tiers
title: Compare quality tiers
